title: Define the instrument accuracy contract
context: Define and enforce the instrument accuracy contract for stock data: fixed

spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Every source has a registry row with terms and attribution.
The raw payload is stored before normalization.
Schema validation covers malformed and missing rows.
Duplicate timestamps collapse to one record.
Stale data is visible and blocks use.
A model cannot write to the data path; CI enforces it.
Tests cover holidays and partial sessions.
